title: Packing list generator tailored to trip and forecast
description: Build a packing list from the trip's planned activities and expected conditions, then organize it by category for easy use.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: packing-list-generator
  title: "Packing list generator tailored to trip and forecast"
  description: Build a packing list from the trip's planned activities and expected conditions, then organize it by category for easy use.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Produce a categorized packing list tailored to the trip's activities and expected weather.
  policies: { maxConcurrency: 2, onFailure: stop, requireApprovalFor: [] }
  nodes:
    - id: intake
      kind: input
      name: Trip details
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required: [text]
        properties:
          text: { type: string, description: Destination, travel dates, planned activities, and traveler count. }
        x-ladder-input-mode: text
    - id: list-builder
      kind: agent
      inlineRole: true
      name: Packing list builder
      role: Trip planner who builds a packing list from activities and expected conditions.
      prompt: Build a packing list based on the planned activities and the general expected weather pattern for the travel window, describing conditions in general terms rather than a specific forecast. Include activity-specific gear and general essentials, and flag that the weather outlook should be re-checked close to departure and the list adjusted if it changes.
      capabilities: { skills: [operations-planning], tools: [read, search], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object, required: [items], properties: { items: { type: array, items: { type: object, properties: { name: { type: string }, category: { type: string } } } }, recheck_note: { type: string } } }
    - id: category-sort
      kind: transform
      name: Group and sort items by category
      config: { operation: sort, expression: "group items by category, then sort alphabetically within each category" }
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Categorized packing list
  edges:
    - { id: e1, from: intake, to: list-builder, kind: data }
    - { id: e2, from: list-builder, to: category-sort, kind: data }
    - { id: e3, from: category-sort, to: result, kind: data }
